text:
Lina: Quick sync — weekly GPU runway flipcheck. Noting two odd signals: APAC-north had a 40% preemptible reclaim spike overnight, and eu-west-2 showed increased cross-AZ egress errors. Posting short snapshots + questions. :eyes:
Mike: saw the APAC reclaim around 02:10 UTC, queue backlog spiked, tail latency up ~220ms. I pushed a temporary scale bump on the us-west pool that absorbed ~12% of requests.
Omar: dug into node events — several NV driver restarts on apac-north-1c, logs show `nvidia-mig-manager` OOM and kubelet evicted pods. Could be a bad kernel/driver combo from last node image roll.
Jess: cost check — if we run the temporary scale bump for 6 hours/day for the next 7 days, rough cost delta is +$4.2k (on-demand). If we shift 25% of that burst to reserved (monthly commit), 3-month ROI ~2.1x. But need commit size and usage shape to be safe.
Lina: thanks. Two asks: (1) Confirm whether driver roll happened in apac node images (Omar), (2) Can infra propose a short-term policy to auto-reroute to eu/US pools when preemptible reclaim >30% for >5m? We need safety until image fix.
Omar: image diff shows a kernel security patch merged 2024-06-14 into the apac image build — not present in eu images. Kernel module ABI mismatch could explain NV processes crashing. Rolling back is heavy; alternative is to cordon+drain nodes preemptively and re-run image build w/ repro.
Mike: for auto-reroute, we can add a routing gate in the smart-router: if region.reclaim_rate > 0.3 and queue_len > 50 then split 30% of new sessions to fallback regions for 10m. I can prototype a flag `route.fallback_split` scoped per-customer.
Jess: add cost guardrails to that gate — e.g., max_spend_delta = $500/day per org, else only failover for infra-critical tenants.
capacity-bot: Canary-verify: apac-north cluster health check FAILED (2/5 checks) — driver-restarts > threshold.
Lina: Omar — timeline? If we patch images and push new AMI, how long to rotate the 120 nodes in apac pool with our rolling window?
Omar: full rotate with current parallelism (10 nodes at a time) ~ 14 hours, with a 20% extra buffer for cordon/drain. I can accelerate to 20 nodes at a time (risk: temporary capacity dip) — would cut to ~7.5 hours.
Mike: operational proposal: (A) enable smart-router fallback gate at 30% reclaim threshold (safe split 20%) — roll tomorrow 09:00 UTC; (B) accelerate image rebuild and rotate nodes with 20-node parallelism during low-traffic window 02:00-10:00 APAC local; (C) add cost cap for failover per Jess.
Jess: +1 on cost cap config. We should also run a quick cost simulation: `python tools/failover_cost.py --hours 8 --split 0.2 --regions us-west,eu-west` and post numbers here.
Lina: good. Mike/Omar — please post a short runbook blurb for on-call and update the capacity playbook. Also call out A/B expectations for latency (we expect +60-120ms on routed sessions).
Omar: putting runbook snippet here:
```
If apac reclaim_rate > 0.3 for 5m:
  - Trigger smart-router: fallback_split=0.2 duration=10m
  - Cordon nodes in apac with driver failures tag
  - Start image-build pipeline with rollback disabled=false
  - If driver restarts persist after rotate, escalate to eng-runtime@oncall
```
Mike: I'll open PR for router gate + flag and wire the cost cap param. Target to have infra tests by EOD PST.
Jess: I'll run the cost sim and post results. If sim > $700/day at 20% split for 8h, we'll reduce split to 10%.
Lina: thanks team. Action items recap: Omar image rebuild + rotation plan (ETA 8h), Mike router gate PR + tests (ETA EOD PST), Jess sim + cap numbers (ETA 2h). Ping me when PRs and sims are up. :thumbsup:
